comparisons.tycho_cost_source: API-equivalent estimate published by Retrodict; Tycho does not disclose a cost figure
comparisons.action_count_comparability: AVO, VISTA, Retrodict, and Kepler publish action counts over different stages and definitions. Kepler's 8,256 is the retained-board-run sum, not the full campaign. The local campaign logs contain at least 13,688 non-reset actions plus 22 unavailable prefix events, so no cross-system or first-time-human percentage is claimed until the complete campaign ledger is reconstructed.
